    "region": ["US", "EU", None, "APAC", None]
}

import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame with missing values
data = {
    "quantity": [10, None, 30, None, 5],
    "region": ["US", "EU", None, "APAC", None]
}
pdf = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert to narwhals DataFrame
df = nw.from_native(pdf)

# Clean the DataFrame: replace nulls in quantity with 0, in region with "unknown"
cleaned_df = df.with_columns(
    nw.col("quantity").fill_null(0),
    nw.col("region").fill_null("unknown")
)

# Convert back to native format
result = cleaned_df.to_native()
print(result)
